tasks.label: Build Game
tasks.detail: Builds game.gba via the devkitARM/libgba Makefile (unchanged toolchain/target).
args: export DEVKITPRO=/opt/devkitpro; export DEVKITARM=/opt/devkitpro/devkitARM; export PATH=$DEVKITARM/bin:$DEVKITPRO/tools/bin:$PATH; cd '${workspaceFolder}' && make

tasks.label: Run Game
tasks.detail: Builds the ROM, verifies game.gba exists, then launches it in mGBA.
args: if (!(Test-Path '${workspaceFolder}\game.gba')) { Write-Error 'game.gba was not found - the build must have failed.'; exit 1 }; Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\Program Files\mGBA\mGBA.exe' -ArgumentList '${workspaceFolder}\game.gba'
